At the restaurant (or coffee) at the end of the meal · the account · everyone wants to pay · decide to split the bill. Exercise 8. a) Šarīf A mint tea, Luca a karkade. The kušari, because it is the most famous dish in Egypt. He asks for it without chili; Šarīf says he must prove it, because without chilli the kušari He doesn't know anything about it. Fūl and ṭaʿmiyya, Egyptian salad and bread. Very hot. They argue: Luca wants to pay because in Milan the guest is Šarīf; Šarīf He says that Luke is his guest; Luke finally offers and Šarīf He'll pay next time. b) A list of food in Cairo. The maḥši Mom's, sugarcane juice on the street and the umm ʿali. A warm dessert with milk and dried fruit. As the sugar wants: sāda, maẓbūṭ or ziyāda; He'll take it. sāda. That you don't need to tip big, but people expect it; and that it is better to drink mineral water and not the tap water.
